name: NCAA D-I South Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Tallahassee, FL · host Florida State · Apalachee Regional Park
headline: NCAA D-I South Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: No. 4 Alabama and No. 8 Florida men; No. 4 Alabama and No. 5 Florida women. The top two teams and the top four individuals not on those teams qualify automatically for the NCAA Championships on Nov. 21. · Women 6K · Men 10K
